title: R5.1-crash: stale reconcile now anchored to durable attempt_started_at (removes wall-clock dependence)
description: R5.1-crash passed a hardcoded reconcile now (2026-10-05T02:00:00Z) while attempt_started_at is minted from real utcnow() at beginDeliveryAttemptEntity. Once wall clock moved past 2026-10-05 the SENDING attempt read as FRESH (negative age vs the 60s stale window), reconcileStaleDeliveryAttempts no-oped, and toThrow(/crash-after-append/) saw undefined — a date-dependent failure on any host, previously registered as a tolerated baseline. The reconcile now is now derived from the durable attempt_started_at +120s, so the attempt is deterministically stale on any date; all post-rollback assertions (state SENDING, started_at unchanged, zero RESOLVED evidence) are unchanged. Test-only change — zero production code touched.
